source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Encourage deep, sustained breathing, helping prevent atelectasis and other post-operative pulmonary complications","B":"Resting on fairly little established evidence-based rationale despite being a routine part of post-operative care","C":"Actually increasing the client's overall risk of developing atelectasis after their surgical procedure","D":"Taking the place of the other pulmonary hygiene measures the client would otherwise still need to perform"}}
source_row.rationale: Incentive spirometry encourages deep, sustained breathing, helping prevent atelectasis and other post-operative pulmonary complications, an important supportive measure typically used alongside (not as a replacement for) other pulmonary hygiene measures like ambulation and coughing.
source_row.source_name: AARC — Incentive Spirometry Clinical Practice Guideline
